note: heapcall-monojit-off-1126 (2026-11-26, merge/cp0-1126 rule-review fixes, NOT RUN): [Crash] HeapCall's HcdOutside (heapcall.cpp) skips only our [MonoJit] region, not Mono's own code manager chunks (private executable memory; no cheap range lookup, Mono is linked into TS3W). An exception in Mono-jitted code (an AV Mono turns into a NullReferenceException) would then log as a heapcall line. This job runs master set m1126b with [MonoJit] Enabled=0, so every managed method runs from Mono's code manager: compare its heapcall lines (eip region, prot, bytes at eip, stack) with the MonoJit-on smoke of master-smoke-m1126. Pass = no crash, detector and version read back, MonoJit off; the heapcall line count is the answer (no limit).
